redFirst.basis: `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py tests/test_stamp_verification.py` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1 on "AttributeError: module 'stamp_verification' has no attribute 'TIMEOUT_PER_COST'" (read as python), and the task introduces 'TIMEOUT_PER_COST': absent from HEAD's module-level bindings of plugins/audit/scripts/governance/stamp-verification.py and bound in the working tree's; a second run with the working tree's implementation copied in exited 0 without that error, its tests reaching their assertions; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR; dependencies linked from the project root, entry by entry as symlinks: node_modules - .cache, .vite, .vite-temp are not linked and a new entry a runner makes beside the links stays in the throwaway, but a write into a linked entry lands in the project's own node_modules and is not watched; no .npmrc to carry or drop; fix run: held back 240s of the deadline (the recorded 266s, capped at half the 480s deadline), the recorded slot-seconds of tests/test_stamp_verification.py in .github/sweep-costs.json

outcome.technical: stamp-verification.py: new sized_deadline(cmd, costs, problem, explicit, default) and deadline_clause(sized); run_red resolves --timeout (parser default now None) after the plan is read: explicit wins, else a sweep command naming suites the cost table times gets ceil(TIMEOUT_PER_COST * their recorded slot-seconds) when above DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, capped at MAX_TIMEOUT, else DEFAULT_TIMEOUT with the reason; every red basis now carries a 'deadline: Ns, <source>' clause before the fix-run hold-back clause; the new-stage basis now says its cases did not exist at HEAD, which is red for them. _red_scope tolerates an unresolved timeout. Reader reuse: the plugin cannot import tools/ (it ships without it), so the existing plugin-side load_sweep_costs is reused (no new parser) and TIMEOUT_PER_COST is held in the plugin and pinned to tools/sweep-selftests.py by case swd5 (factor, same table entries, and file_timeout agreement for one suite). PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md deadline paragraph updated (edit allowed by the plan gate). Tests: new stage swd-block with swd1-swd6; ran sweep over test_stamp_verification, test__deps, test__output_lints, test_drive_phase: 4/4 files ok; ruff clean.
outcome.descriptive: The red-first helper sizes its deadline from a sweep command's recorded cost and states the deadline and its source in every basis.
